QuestInfo.name: A Hairy Situation
QuestInfo.0: What kind of magic did Marshall work on the wig?
QuestInfo.1: Marshall did a bang-up job on that wig! Time for the moment of truth... Will Blake approve? Take it to him and find out.
QuestInfo.2: Blake says that Marshall has passed his prime and refuses to wear the wig. Seriously?

0.0: The wig's finished! Well, isn't it fabulous? I just KNOW that this is the style that Blake's been waiting for. Hurry, take this to him.

yes.0: I know Blake will like the wig, but if he somehow doesn't then let Tina know that I refuse to work with anyone who can't appreciate the beauty of my work.

no.0: This wig is for Blake. Don't be jealous.

1.0: ...A wig this time rather than a hat? Okay let's take a look. Marshall did this, right?

yes.0: Really? Who wears a bright blonde wig nowadays? Poor Marshall... He was a bigshot stylist back in his day, but it's pretty clear how far he's fallen. There's no way I'm wearing this thing.
yes.1: I absolutely refuse to wear this wig to the autograph event. Tell Tina to work harder.

npc.0: Take this fabulous wig to Blake.

item.0: Sigh... When are these preparations going to end?
